name: farm-landscape
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original artwork for a premium Vegan Valley farm-to-cold-pressed-juice scroll storytelling page, NOT a website mockup.
Style/medium: sophisticated editorial botanical coloured-pencil drawing combined with tactile paper-cut diorama, detailed fine forest-green pencil outlines, botanically accurate subjects, premium food-brand art direction, light grain and soft natural papercraft shadows. Not childish or cartoonish. No photorealism.
Color palette: full-bleed pale green paper ground #eef2e6, sage #b9cf9f, forest-green #2f5a2c outlines; warm natural produce colours sparingly, including ochre carrots and muted beet red.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, elevated three-quarter viewpoint. Key subject across the central and right portions, LEFT THIRD mostly empty for web typography overlay. All artwork fades softly into the same pale green ground near the outer edges. No important details cropped. Airy, beautifully detailed composition.
Constraints: no type, logos, lettering, watermarks, or website UI. No people or hands.

Primary request: expansive idyllic vegetable garden and orchard landscape rolling down a gentle hill, neat curved rows of leafy greens, carrot fronds and beet leaves in foreground, small apple and citrus trees midground, layered distant green hills, a tiny farm building near far right.
Lighting/mood: early morning softness, wonderful depth and winding planting rows that guide the eye through the scene.
Composition specifics: farmland fills the lower two-thirds and right two-thirds; pale green sky and ground in the upper left and left third stay empty. Detailed pencil drawing visible at large size.
Avoid: people, machinery, flags, photorealism.

Primary request: elegant unbranded compact stainless-steel hydraulic cold-press juice machine on a clean simple workbench, with a credible rectangular pressing chamber/basket and compact mechanism. A small clear pitcher of golden-orange juice sits beneath its outlet. A modest arrangement of washed carrots, apples, lemon and leafy greens sits at its side.
Composition specifics: central-right composition, left third blank pale green. Detailed fine forest-green pencil lines and softly shaded silver metal within the same handdrawn paper-diorama style.
Constraints: machine must read as a hydraulic juice press, NOT a blender, coffee machine or centrifuge. This is a conceptual storytelling illustration, no claims of a specific real facility.
Avoid: spinning blade, electrical sparks, factory claims, industrial conveyor belts, text, branding.
